themes.title: Far-right parties push 'national priority' policies
themes.blurb: Right-wing and far-right parties across Europe are intensifying demands for 'national priority' policies, prioritizing citizens over immigrants in public services, housing, and welfare. This theme is particularly prominent in Spain, Italy, and France, where parties like Vox, Lega, and Rassemblement National are leveraging their electoral gains to influence coalition governments and shape national agendas.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Demands 'national priority' in Andalusia, Extremadura, and Aragón, forcing PP to negotiate for government formation.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Lega pushes for stricter citizenship laws and revocation of residency permits for criminals, framing it as a national security issue.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Advocates for policies favoring French citizens in welfare and housing, aligning with broader far-right European trends.

countries.name: 🇩🇪 Alternative für Deutschland
countries.note: Proposes policies to prioritize German citizens in social benefits and public services, echoing similar rhetoric.

countries.name: 🇬🇧 Reform UK
countries.note: Calls for ending social housing for immigrants and deporting 'illegal migrants,' reflecting a UK-specific version of 'national priority'.

themes.title: Trump’s policies dominate global right-wing coverage
themes.blurb: Donald Trump's domestic and foreign policies continue to shape right-wing narratives worldwide, with his administration's actions—such as the Iran conflict, immigration reforms, and economic strategies—being closely monitored and often emulated by right-wing parties in Europe and Latin America. This theme highlights the transnational influence of Trumpism on global conservative movements.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: Trump's policies on Iran, immigration, and economic nationalism are central to right-wing discourse, with frequent coverage of his administration's decisions.

countries.name: 🇵🇱 Prawo i Sprawiedliwość
countries.note: PiS frequently references Trump's policies, particularly on immigration and defense, to justify its own agenda.

countries.name: 🇦🇷 La Libertad Avanza
countries.note: Javier Milei's government aligns with Trump's economic liberalism and anti-socialist rhetoric, often citing Trump as an inspiration.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Meloni and Salvini often reference Trump's hardline stance on immigration and national sovereignty in their political messaging.

countries.name: 🇬🇧 Reform UK
countries.note: Nigel Farage and Reform UK frequently invoke Trump's policies, particularly on Brexit and immigration, to bolster their platform.

themes.title: Rise of far-right parties in European polls
themes.blurb: Far-right parties across Europe are experiencing a surge in popularity, with polls indicating significant gains in countries like Germany, Sweden, and Spain. This theme reflects the growing electoral success of parties such as AfD, Sverigedemokraterna, and Vox, which are reshaping the political landscape and challenging traditional center-right and center-left parties.

countries.name: 🇩🇪 Alternative für Deutschland
countries.note: AfD leads polls in Saxony-Anhalt and Mecklenburg-Vorpommern, with nationwide support reaching 29%.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Vox gains influence in Andalusia, becoming kingmaker in regional government formation and surpassing PSOE in several municipalities.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: RN continues to poll strongly ahead of the 2027 French presidential election, with Jordan Bardella as a key figure.

countries.name: 🇸🇪 Sverigedemokraterna
countries.note: SD maintains strong polling numbers, influencing Sweden's migration and welfare policies.

countries.name: 🇭🇺 Fidesz / Tisza
countries.note: Fidesz's decline contrasts with Tisza Party's rise, reflecting shifting political dynamics in Hungary.

themes.title: Internal divisions within far-right parties
themes.blurb: Far-right parties in Europe and the Americas are grappling with internal divisions, as factions clash over leadership, policy direction, and strategic alliances. These conflicts are particularly evident in parties like Poland's PiS, Hungary's Fidesz, Argentina's La Libertad Avanza, and Germany's AfD, where infighting threatens to undermine their electoral success and policy coherence.

countries.name: 🇵🇱 Prawo i Sprawiedliwość
countries.note: PiS faces internal strife over leadership and policy direction, with factions led by Morawiecki and Czarnek clashing publicly.

countries.name: 🇭🇺 Fidesz / Tisza
countries.note: Fidesz's historic election defeat has led to internal recriminations, while Tisza Party struggles with its own leadership challenges.

countries.name: 🇦🇷 La Libertad Avanza
countries.note: Javier Milei's government faces infighting between factions led by Santiago Caputo and the Menem family, threatening policy stability.

countries.name: 🇩🇪 Alternative für Deutschland
countries.note: AfD experiences internal disputes, with figures like Matthias Moosdorf facing fines and suspensions for criticizing party leadership.

countries.name: 🇬🇧 Reform UK
countries.note: Reform UK faces internal tensions over candidate selection and policy direction, with some members accused of extremism.

themes.title: Energy crisis fuels EU fiscal rule debates
themes.blurb: The ongoing energy crisis in Europe has reignited debates over EU fiscal rules, with countries like Italy, Germany, and Spain pushing for greater flexibility to address soaring energy costs. This theme highlights the tension between national governments seeking to protect their economies and the EU's insistence on maintaining fiscal discipline.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Meloni urges EU to extend fiscal flexibility to energy spending, citing economic risks from high energy prices.

countries.name: 🇩🇪 Alternative für Deutschland
countries.note: AfD criticizes EU fiscal rules, advocating for national control over energy policies to address rising costs.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Vox demands energy policies that prioritize Spanish citizens, aligning with broader right-wing critiques of EU fiscal constraints.

countries.name: 🇵🇱 Prawo i Sprawiedliwość
countries.note: PiS proposes reforms to make energy bills more transparent, blaming EU climate policies for high costs.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: RN criticizes EU energy policies, advocating for national solutions to protect French consumers.
